result.note: Arrays are float32 .npy in the pass folder; row i corresponds to ids[i] in meta.json. Hidden layer index 0 is the embedding output, 6 is the last encoder layer of the edited model. cls_hidden is position 0 (the <s> token, which feeds the classification head). Attention arrays are [n, 12 heads, T, T] for encoder layers 1..6. meta.json has layer_map: edited-model layer index -> original layer id.
